description: Election Commission - Mr. J. S. P. S. Nandasiri of the Dehiaththakandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Dehiaththakandiya Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for local authorities, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
